prompt: wget time-stamping Content-Length size mismatch behavior
answer:
With Wget time-stamping (`-N`/`--timestamping`), Wget compares the local file size with the remote `Content-Length`. If the sizes differ, it downloads the remote file regardless of the timestamps.

If the server does not provide `Content-Length`—for example, when compression produces a variable-length response—the size check cannot be performed. `--ignore-length` can also disable use of the `Content-Length` header.
